page.layout: One printed page, left part of a two-column index; a title line at top, then a table of Cap., Verf. and Pag. columns under the heading MATTHÆUS.; One page of an index, in three columns: at the top left a running head "Index IV." across the page; below it a narrow column of page numbers (pag.) on the left, then a column headed "Cap. Vers." with chapter numbers and verse references, to the right of it. Only the left part of the printed page is visible.; One column of table lines, right of centre, with the header "Cap. | Vers. | Pag." at the head and "Cap." at the foot; the left-hand column is cut off at the edge.
page.notes: The first page-number entries are partly damaged and some digits are doubtful (e.g. "13" for I., "1082,109" possibly "108,109"). Cut-off right portion of the page is not transcribed. Page number not printed in this part. Only the left part of the page is visible; the right-hand columns are cut off. The verse references at the right of the Cap. column are partly legible, and the page number column is read from its trailing digits. The left-hand part of the table is cut off; only the right-hand columns of Vers. and Pag. are legible. Numbers are copied as printed, with the old form of the figure 1 and 2 shown as in the scan.
